name: Skull Cave / Печера Черепа

Jungle translates Ukrainian tropical-wood wording; all dry. Platform bottom slabs, stairs north-rising, isolated vertical fence supports with all horizontal connections false.
Five hanging=true ceiling lights, no speculative chains or underwater lights. Count inferred.

Persistent leaves, distance7 because no logs. Vines attached to south-side supporting blocks. Keep intended leaf state even if production parser reports mismatch.

uncertainty: No pixel-perfect or hidden-geometry guarantee: two photographed perspective spreads do not expose every voxel. This is an audited, explicit reconstruction, not an exact recoverable plan.

Printed entrance contradiction: total height11 versus five upper + four lower =9 specified rows. Preserve total11 and both widths; infer two middle width7 rows. Choosing width9 there would also fit the incomplete prose.
Printed20x15x13 is the host location, not a fully dimensioned skull. Retained exactly as host box. Complete20x16x16 envelope includes3 northward facade cells and one leaf layer above grass.

Skull13-wide,13-row silhouette, jaw curve, eye pixels, nose, forehead, depth projections, stair orientations and slab halves are inferred from master render and assembly insets. Main face z1, backing z2, frontmost accents z0.

Excavation depth12 is retained. Hidden chamber14-wide, throat2-deep, ceiling and floor levels, one-block rear wall and widened treasure alcoves are inferred. No unsupported claim that chamber shape is fully visible.
Platform size/height, two stairs, fence count, five lantern count, treasure pile species/count/positions and chest states inferred. No chest contents or extra functional mechanisms.

Water seen in master render and diagrams is deliberately omitted under no-fluid rule; no ocean/basin/river apron replacement. Boat/player/entities omitted. Dry route is not a functional boat entrance and no live/physics/navigation test performed.

Final roof foliage distribution is inferred, not a solid second grass canopy. Jungle leaves persistent to prevent decay, no invented logs. Production reader leaf-distance conversion issue may affect reconstructed states and must be reported without workaround.
No source/dependency/unrelated files changed; only folder13 artifacts and folder13 report row are authorized. No entities, fluids or complex block-entity NBT.
